title: Taming the Option Factor Zoo: A High-Dimensional Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2609.31263v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Option-implied factors are largely, but not entirely, spanned by the equity factor zoo. We construct 137 option-implied characteristics for optionable U.S. stocks from 2004 to 2023, screen them to 20 representative long-short factors, and test each against 160 equity factors with the double-selection LASSO of Feng, Giglio, and Xiu (2020). In-sample, the equity factors account for about 91% of the option factors' variance, and adding the option factors does not significantly raise the maximum Sharpe ratio. Individually, however, 8 of the 20 option factors, mainly measures of jump tails, kurtosis, and implied-volatility convexity, have non-zero SDF loadings after controlling for the equity zoo, and 4 remain significant after a Bonferroni correction. Options thus add a few pricing-relevant dimensions rather than a new factor zoo.

translated_title: 驯服期权因子动物园：一项高维度分析
translated_abstract: 期权隐含因子在很大程度上（但并非完全）被股票因子动物园所张成。我们为2004年至2023年间可交易期权的美国股票构建了137个期权隐含特征，将其筛选为20个代表性的多空因子，并使用Feng、Giglio和Xiu（2020）的双选择LASSO方法将每个期权因子与160个股票因子进行检验。在样本内，股票因子解释了期权因子约91%的方差，加入期权因子并不能显著提高最大夏普比率。然而，就单个因子而言，20个期权因子中有8个——主要是跳跃尾部、峰度和隐含波动率凸性的度量——在控制股票因子动物园后仍具有非零的随机贴现因子（SDF）载荷，其中4个在经过Bonferroni校正后依然显著。因此，期权为资产定价增加的是少数几个相关维度，而非一个新的因子动物园。
tldr: 该研究通过双选择LASSO方法将137个期权隐含因子与160个股票因子进行高维对比检验，发现股票因子可解释期权因子约91%的方差，但少数涉及跳跃尾部、峰度和隐含波动率凸性的期权因子在控制股票因子后仍具有独立的资产定价贡献。
en_tdlr: Using double-selection LASSO to test 137 option-implied factors against 160 equity factors, this study finds that equity factors span about 91% of option factor variance, yet a few option factors—mainly measures of jump tails, kurtosis, and implied-volatility convexity—retain independent pricing relevance after controlling for the equity zoo.
